title: Machine learning classification of multiple sclerosis patients based on raw data from an instrumented walkway
summary: The study reports that adding novel spatial foot features improved accuracy by 7% in the study cohort. The result is limited to the evaluated clinical cohort and gait protocol; it does not establish disease progression prediction or broader clinical benefit.
ai_technology: Instrumented-walkway gait features classify multiple-sclerosis patients versus controls.
